recordDecisions.title: Modular Schur numbers — current scope and verification limits
recordDecisions.dateBasis: Existing first-public date preserved. Palomar version 2 dated 11 October is a later scope/provenance event.
recordDecisions.boundedClaim: The paper reports that, for m >= 2 and ell >= 2, with n = m/gcd(m,ell-1), S_m(k,ell) = n-1 for every k >= n-1. It also gives S_m(1,ell) = min(ell-1,floor(m/ell)) for 2 <= ell <= m and the stated prime-modulus threshold k_0(p,ell) = p-1 when ell >= p-1 and ell is not 1 modulo p. The composite threshold remains open. The author’s current draft correction note additionally reports that a published prime-power middle branch fails at S_8(3,8), and replaces it by S_(p^i)(k,ell)=p^i-1 for k>=i(p-1) when p does not divide ell-1; this prose correction is not formalized.
